description:
We are looking for a Middle Salesforce Developer to join our team and work directly with our partner.

Our client is on an incredible journey to become the universal symbol of trust. As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement. With over 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users, the work we do together has a massive global impact, helping millions of people make better choices every day.

Contract duration: Until mid-March for now, with the possibility of extension.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, LWC, and Flows.
  • Build and maintain REST/SOAP and other API integrations.
  • Develop and optimize Salesforce automation and workflows.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting.
  • Work with GitHub, Salesforce CLI, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders and support junior team members.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce Developer/Administrator experience, preferably with Service Cloud.
  • Strong knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce Flows.
  • Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience with REST/SOAP/Bulk APIs and Salesforce security models.
  • Experience with unit testing, debugging, GitHub, Salesforce CLI, and CI/CD.
  • Good English and strong communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer or Advanced Administrator.
  • Experience with Experience Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Agentforce.
  • Knowledge of integration architecture patterns.

What We Offer

  • Remote work with flexibility across Europe.
  • International environment and collaboration with a global engineering team.
